status: frozen before new group splits, estimation or forecast computations
cases: All 24 released fixed LLM cells across four contexts, two original replicas and three coverage levels.

evaluation.design: Each of the 35 H-target people is held out once in a complete five-fold rotation within context and original split. Coverage variants share folds. Holdout labels and predictions do not select weights or fit coefficients. The old H evaluation findings are known. This is a retrospective independent refit split within a released study.

labels.design: Primary retains all 15 V-target people; secondary divides the same 15 into three disjoint groups of 5. Each label group is crossed with all five evaluation folds. Prediction pools and outcomes come from the published workbooks.

methods.fixed_unit: unit weight with archive-compatible support LP
methods.released_rule: recompute published opt-out variance rule only on the new L and U
methods.labelled_MLE: same labelled menus with ordinary fit
methods.labelled_ridge: same labelled menus with mean-loss ridge at 0.01
methods.prompt_matched_MLE: ordinary fit on labels and the union of distinct menu outcomes used as prompt examples for fitting-sample predictions
methods.prompt_matched_ridge: same prompt-matched labelled menus with mean-loss ridge at 0.01
methods.raw_LLM: frozen probabilities for the actual held-out group

fallback: When safe, unit or retuned released compensation lacks a verified unpenalized fit, apply same-label ridge. Prompt-matched MLE has a matched-ridge fallback. Record each reason. Do not count fallback as an unpenalized estimate.
prompt_cost: Reconstruct human exemplars by the deposited split and Hamming-neighbor algorithms. Take their exact first two complete menus per used neighbor. Use only exemplars for L/U predictions and preserve duplicates as a single human observation. This counts observed in-context study labels; model training costs are outside the archive.
metrics: unique labelled and in-context menu counts
scope: Repeated folds within one released RADIANT study and 24 dependent cells. Separate 15- and 5-person budgets. No new prompts, predictor fitting, labels, people, or Monte Carlo trial estimates. No population inference.
